### Shared Utilities Strategy

All shared modules live in `shared/` and are imported via the `/shared` alias configured in `vite.config.js`. Every game imports only what it needs — no circular dependencies. The shared layer provides:

| Module | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `GameEngine` | Fixed-timestep loop, hit-stop timescale controller, frame delta management |
| `Renderer` | Three.js scene, camera, renderer init; `EffectComposer` + `UnrealBloomPass` setup |
| `CameraController` | Trauma-based shake: on impact, add trauma value → exponential decay each frame |
| `PostProcessing` | Bloom config, motion blur accumulation, hit-stop frame freeze (scale = 0) |
| `InputManager` | Unified keyboard + gamepad input with deadzone handling and button remapping |
| `ObjectPool<T>` | Generic pool: `acquire()`, `release()`, pre-warmed capacity, zero GC pressure |
| `ParticleManager` | Hard cap at 500 particles; manages burst, trail, spark, shockwave lifecycles |
| `CameraShake` | Dedicated shake system: intensity decay curve, per-axis randomization |
| `HitStop` | Timescale = 0.1 for ~80ms on heavy hits, then ramp back to 1.0 |
| `MotionTrail` | Stores previous positions → renders trail geometry (line or instanced quads) |
| `FloatingText` | HTML overlay positioned via screen-space projection of 3D world position |
| `AudioSynth` | Web Audio API: oscillator-based SFX (square, sawtooth, noise bursts) |
| `AABB` / `Raycaster` / `Vec3Util` | Collision math primitives — no physics engine dependency |
| `InstancedBuilder` | Creates `InstancedMesh` from a template geometry + per-instance matrix/color |
| `MaterialFactory` | Pre-configured `MeshStandardMaterial` presets (emissive neon, metallic roughness) |
